original_query: select  i_brand_id brand_id, i_brand brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact,  	sum(ss_ext_sales_price) ext_price   from date_dim, store_sales, item,customer,customer_address,store   where  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk     and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk     and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk     and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk     and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk     AND i_category  = 'Books'     and d_year=1999     and d_moy = 7     and substring(ca_zip,1,5) <> substring(s_zip,1,5)     and ca_state  = 'IN'     and c_birth_month = 10     and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77  group by i_brand       ,i_brand_id       ,i_manufact_id       ,i_manufact  order by ext_price desc          ,i_brand          ,i_brand_id          ,i_manufact_id          ,i_manufact limit 100 ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT i.i_brand_id      AS brand_id,
       i.i_brand         AS brand,
       i.i_manufact_id,
       i.i_manufact,
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price
FROM date_dim d
JOIN store_sales ss       ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i               ON ss.ss_item_sk      = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c           ON ss.ss_customer_sk  = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca  ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s              ON ss.ss_store_sk      = s.s_store_sk
WHERE i.i_category = 'Books'
  AND d.d_year = 1999
  AND d.d_moy = 7
  AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77
  AND c.c_birth_month = 10
  AND ca.ca_state = 'IN'
  AND SUBSTRING(ca.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> SUBSTRING(s.s_zip, 1, 5)
GROUP BY i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id, i.i_manufact_id, i.i_manufact
ORDER BY ext_price DESC,
         i.i_brand,
         i.i_brand_id,
         i.i_manufact_id,
         i.i_manufact
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Converted the implicit comma-join syntax into explicit INNER JOIN ... ON clauses, making join predicates explicit and enabling the planner to push filters more reliably.

Reordered the WHERE filters to place selective sargable predicates (d_year, d_moy, i_category, ss_wholesale_cost, c_birth_month, ca_state) before the non-sargable SUBSTRING zip comparison, which is applied late on few rows.
No CTEs were introduced: with many join conditions and no redundant subquery computation, inlining CTEs would provide no benefit and could risk optimization fencing.
